zones.label: Privacy
zones.summary: Protect passwords, location, personal details, and image-sharing permission.
facts: Use privacy settings and strong unique passwords.
Ask before posting another person’s image or story.
Backgrounds and metadata can reveal more than intended.

zones.label: Pressure
zones.summary: Repeated demands, secrecy, and urgency can signal unhealthy control.
facts: Healthy relationships allow time and independent choices.
No one is entitled to passwords or constant replies.
Pressure that continues after a boundary needs support.

zones.label: Harm
zones.summary: Online harm can include exclusion, rumors, impersonation, threats, or unwanted sharing.
facts: The target is not responsible for another person’s harmful choice.
Move toward safety and trusted support.

zones.label: Report
zones.summary: Reporting can connect evidence with adults, schools, platforms, or emergency help.
facts: Save relevant evidence only when it is safe and appropriate.
Tell a trusted adult even if you are uncertain.
Use emergency services for immediate danger.

zones.label: Exit and Support
zones.summary: Block, mute, leave, adjust settings, and connect with supportive people.
facts: Safety matters more than finishing an argument.
A trusted adult can help plan next steps.
Keep seeking help if the harm continues.
